notes.title: Need a hint?
notes.notes:
Stuck? Need a quick hint to keep you going? No worries! Email us at support@brahngames.com with HINT in the title and let us know "where" in the room you are at, and what the latest "puzzle" you solved is - oh, and what was your last achievement, if any.

No spoilers! We won't give you the answer and ruin the surprises, but we will try to give you enough to help you find the answers yourself - which is what its all about and much more fun.

Happy escaping!

-  Brahn Games Dev Team
